link.note: Named as André's wife in the 1695 Bristol baptism (confirmed); her Cozes baptism and parents are probable.

bio:
Born 9 Dec, baptized 19 Dec 1666 at Cozes, daughter of 'the deceased Daniel Delatour and Jeanne Meurail' (Garner p.69; probable). Wife of André Lamoureux; mother of Daniel (Bristol 1695).

The French Church of New York register has a 'Susanne de la tour' as godmother in May 1700, the month André Lamoureux is first recorded in New York ([R4-S1]). This is probably André's wife, using her maiden name in the French manner. In 1720 a 'Susanne la Moureux' was godmother to her grandson Daniel; the Davenport genealogy treats this as her last appearance ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).
sources: Kenn True Garner, The French Reformed Church, Cozes, Saintonge: Baptisms 1655-1668 (FamilySearch Books); FHL film 1868505 item 5 p.69
Lart, Huguenot Soc. London vol. 20 p.9

[R4-S1] Wittmeyer (ed.), Registers of the Église Françoise à la Nouvelle York (Huguenot Soc. Collections vol.1, 1886), pp.72 and 155 (derivative) https://archive.org/stream/collectionsofhug01hugu/collectionsofhug01hugu_djvu.txt
[R4-S2] Giles, Thomas Davenport, Pioneer, and His Descendants, Section X p.355 (secondary) https://archive.org/stream/thomasdavenportp00gile/thomasdavenportp00gile_djvu.txt
